title: Simultaneous symmetric coefficient-system calculus
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R$, uniformizer $\varpi$, and positive quotients $A_{n+1}=R/\varpi^{n+1}$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For a scheme $W$, use strict semilinear coefficient systems and their ordinary derived category and exact evaluations [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus, def-coef-finite-adjunction-system-data]. For every scheme W there exists one coefficient-derived-system calculus S, with its resolution coherence, and a symmetric structure beta on S.systemClosed.monoidal whose tensor coherence uses the very same S.systemTensorModel. The unitors, associator and symmetry are normalized by the total tensor models [lem-sf-ringed-derived-closed-symmetric-monoidal].

proof.text: Run the simultaneous K-flat/K-injective construction of the derived evaluation calculus with the signed total tensor on the sequence site. Its closed structure and tensor model are the same models used in the ringed closed symmetric monoidal construction. Signed swap, reassociation, and coefficient multiplication supply the constraints; check their equations on pure tensor summands and descend along K-flat localization. The representative-normalized fiber/global comparisons and the constraints thus belong to a common calculus witness.
